Mexican special forces arrest drug kingpin 'Chapo Isidro'

The alleged leader of the Beltran Leyva gang and one of the FBI's most wanted fugitives, known as 'Chapo Isidro,' was captured by the Mexican military following a raid and a shootout in the coastal Sinaloa state.

[Source 2 — www.theguardian.com (Bias: Left / Progressive)] (URL: https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/21/alleged-mexican-drug-cartel-boss-el-chapo-isidro-meza-flores-arrested):
Alleged Mexican drug cartel boss ‘El Chapo Isidro’ arrested in special forces raid

Fausto Isidro Meza Flores was one of FBI’s most wanted fugitives and evaded capture for more than a decadeThe Mexican military captured one of the FBI’s 10 most wanted fugitives during a special forces raid in the Mexican state of Sinaloa on Friday night.Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as “El Chapo Isidro”, was arrested along with two other alleged leaders of his gang after a gun battle that triggered widespread panic in the city of Guasave.
